newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Oakwell in US$200 mln Indian power deals.
newsitem.headline: Oakwell in US$200 mln Indian power deals.

text.p: Singapore's Oakwell Engineering Ltd said on Monday it signed two power purchase agreements with the Andhra Pradesh State Electricity Board, India, worth about US$100 million each.
Oakwell said in a statement the two agreements had been secured on a build-own-operate basis over a period of 15 years.

"The company shall build and operate the two liquid-fuel based diesel cycle barge mounted power plants of 100 MW each, and shall sell the electricity to the board at a competitive rate over the contract periods," it said.
The statement gave no other details.
